integrity: The cited Apéry and Frobenius formulas are attributed to their original authors. All new computations and proof transformations are stated explicitly. This document does not represent independent certification or publication.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for a>=5 only, derived using the published Apéry-set theorem for the same family; does not classify other gap patterns or other numerical semigroups. The symbolic proof is accompanied by finite checks but has not received independent validation. A closed-form derivation could have been implicit in prior Zeckendorf research.
title: Isolated gaps in Fibonacci-shifted numerical semigroups
